summary:
Russia’s overnight attack on Ukraine killed at least 11 people, according to Ukrainian authorities. The air force said Russia launched 130 drones and 48 cruise and ballistic missiles; President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said intelligence indicated another large-scale attack was being prepared. Kenya confirmed its first Bundibugyo Ebola case in a man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo and later died. Officials identified 28 contacts, and Nairobi Hospital said the patient had been isolated.

In Yemen, Houthi forces attacked Aden’s international airport with missiles and explosive-laden drones as fighting intensified. The Yemeni government said a missile hit the runway minutes before a flight from Cairo was due to land. France suspended police use of stun grenades at student protests after days of demonstrations and complaints of excessive force; the protests have spread to more than 40 cities.

The United States formally asked Russia for information after a worker at a Siberian plague research institute died, and President Donald Trump said he would discuss the case with Vladimir Putin. Russia denies plague caused the death; nearly 200 contacts were placed under observation. In Canada, US authorities arrested a man accused of advising and offering support to the suspect in a school shooting that killed eight people. Israel marked three years since the October 7 attacks with memorials, including a moment of silence at the Nova festival site, where more than 300 people were killed.

headlines.title: Russia launches major attack on Ukraine, killing at least 11
headlines.summary: Russia launched an overnight attack involving 130 drones and 48 cruise and ballistic missiles, Ukraine’s air force said. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said intelligence showed Russia was preparing a further large-scale attack.

headlines.title: Kenya reports first Ebola case and death
headlines.summary: Kenya confirmed its first case of Bundibugyo Ebola in a man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo and later died. Health officials identified 28 contacts, while Nairobi Hospital said the patient had been isolated.

headlines.title: Houthis strike Aden airport as Yemen fighting intensifies
headlines.summary: Yemen’s Houthis attacked Aden airport with missiles and explosive-laden drones, the country’s Transport Ministry said. One missile hit the runway minutes before a flight from Cairo was due to land, according to the Yemeni government.

headlines.title: France suspends stun grenades at student protests
headlines.summary: France suspended police use of stun grenades at student demonstrations after days of protests and complaints of excessive force. The move followed reports that a boy had lost a hand, and comes as protests have spread to more than 40 cities.

headlines.title: US presses Russia for details on reported plague-lab death
headlines.summary: The United States formally asked Russia for information after a worker at a Siberian plague research institute died; President Donald Trump said he would discuss the case with Vladimir Putin. Russian authorities deny that plague caused the death, and nearly 200 contacts were placed under observation.

headlines.title: US arrests alleged accomplice in Canada school shooting
headlines.summary: US authorities arrested James Cody Bryant, accusing him of advising and offering support to the suspect in a deadly school shooting in British Columbia. The shooting earlier this year left eight people dead.

headlines.title: Israel marks three years since October 7 attacks
headlines.summary: Families gathered at memorials across Israel to mark three years since Hamas’s October 7, 2023 attack. At the Nova music festival site, where more than 300 people were killed, families held a moment of silence.
